serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Little_Richard: I have some bad news.
AbusedTenant: What do you mean? 
Little_Richard: Basically, Admin said it’s too risky for us to get involved…
AbusedTenant: What?!
AbusedTenant: What am I supposed to do?
Little_Richard: He said that if you think your life is really in danger you should delete your blog account, fry your hard drive and go to the police and tell them someone is following you. You should be relatively safe then.
AbusedTenant: Are you kidding me? I have things I can’t destroy in my place! Involving the police is out of the question! 
Little_Richard: Fuck…
Little_Richard: Listen, I have another plan. It’s risky, but if everything goes well your problem with DAK should disappear.
AbusedTenant: What’s your plan? 
Little_Richard: We will use you as bait and when DAK will come close to you, I will be there to take him out.
AbusedTenant: How are you planning to take him out?
Little_Richard: I still have his gun, remember?
He wants to kill him? 
AbusedTenant: Are you sure about it? 
Little_Richard: About what?
AbusedTenant: About killing DAK? 
Little_Richard: It’s not like I want to do it, I’m not a psycho, but what other choice do we have? You are in my squad and it’s my responsibility to help you.
AbusedTenant: Even though Admin told you to do nothing?
Little_Richard: Disagreements happen, but I would lie if I told you I’m content with his decision…
Little_Richard: Don’t worry, I did some shooting like a decade ago, it should be fine.
That does not sound like a lot of experience…
Little_Richard: Do you want me to help you or not? 
AbusedTenant: I don’t have much of a choice…
Little_Richard: Listen. Next time you go outside, send me a message.
Little_Richard: I will be waiting at coordinates I will send you later. We only have one chance at this, so be careful!.
AbusedTenant: Sure…
Little_Richard: After everything is over, I will have to clean up and find out where DAK lived so I can destroy all the evidence connecting him to the blog so you better get out of there as soon as possible!
AbusedTenant: I understand…
Little_Richard: I’m waiting for your signal
I don’t think it’s a good idea and I have mixed feelings about DAK being gunned down in some alleyway, but it seems like there’s no other way.
It’s me or him and he’s the one set on revenge. I just want to defend my wellbeing…
